label: last output step of length-3 sequences; weakly, 3rd original input when it is s/d/i/c/r/0
explanation: Two unrelated components. (1) Strong: the final copy step (t=5, outputting the 3rd token) of L=3 sequences; fires on ~99% of such steps and holds ~61% of activation mass, including all top activations (up to max). Weaker echoes at the last step of L=4 (~8% rate, ~7% mass). (2) Weak but frequent: the original-phase step t=2 (third input token), mostly when that input is s, d, i, c, r or 0 (rates ~70% for s, ~60% for d, lower for others); activations here are small (~0.15 of max) and hold ~30% of mass. Never fires at t=0,1, the delimiter, or mid-copy steps of longer sequences. The token choice of component 2 limits precision.
